description: This file defines a React component named DeploymentStatusBarChart that renders a themed, accessible bar chart using the 'recharts' library to visualize deployment statuses with counts. It includes internal methods for rendering tooltips, labels, and handles user interactions like clicking bars and legend items.

methods.name: CustomTooltip
methods.description: A React component used to display a custom tooltip with deployment status and count when hovering over bars.

methods.name: ValueLabel
methods.description: A React component that renders the numeric value label above each bar, positioned centrally.

methods.name: auditLogInteraction
methods.description: Function that logs user interactions (like bar or legend clicks) for auditing purposes, including user token presence and action details.
